tagline: Core Main, Inc. is a leading distributor of products and services for water and wastewater, storm drainage, and geo-environmental markets.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is the primary indicator of the company's ability to manage its production costs and maintain profitability in a competitive market. It reflects operational efficiency and pricing strategy.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting the cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin measures the efficiency of production and direct cost management. A healthy gross margin is essential to cover other operating expenses and generate net profit.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales after deductions for returns, discounts, and allowances.
kpis.description: Net sales represent the total revenue generated from the sale of goods and services. It is a key indicator of commercial performance and market demand.
kpis.signal: Indicator of company size and growth.

kpis.name: Credit Risk Exposure
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue coming from the 50 largest customers, reflecting concentration of credit risk.
kpis.description: The company is exposed to credit risk on its trade receivables. This risk is mitigated by a broad and diversified customer base, with the top 50 customers representing only 12% of net sales. The largest customer accounts for 1% of net sales.
kpis.signal: Low customer concentration, mitigated by a diversified base.

kpis.name: Fabrication Services Revenue %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue derived from light fabrication activities.
kpis.description: Light fabrication services, including fire protection and drainage, represent less than 5% of net sales, but are considered products with significant growth opportunities.
kpis.signal: Marginal fabrication activity, focused on niche markets.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four reported fiscal years.
